settle: After the PR body is on the PR and before resolving `deliver`, run `fr pr settle --wait 300`: on exit 4 fix it, a conflict by merging `origin/<base>` into the branch (never rebase or force-push) and a red check by an ordinary commit, otherwise do what the printed line says, push with `fr push` and run it again; on exit 75 run it again; on exit 2 fix what it names (open the PR, correct the override) and run it again, which is not a fix round; after three fix rounds stop and report. `deliver` stays refused until the PR settles or a `settle.<key>: <mode> — <reason>` line in the spec's `## Verification` relaxes the key; CI cannot run on a conflicting PR, so a relaxed `settle.conflicts` leaves `settle.ci` `unrunnable` until it is relaxed too or the conflict is resolved. After the `deliver` resolve's push, run it once more under the same loop (a fix then is a commit after `deliver`) and report the result.
